title: GH Real Estate Canonical Zoho Sign Recipient and Final-Signer Policy
scope: All GH Real Estate contract documents sent from Zoho Contracts to Zoho Sign

official_sources.title: Zoho Sign — Add document fields using text tags
Zoho Sign — Send documents for signatures

recipient_index_policy.rule: R<n> identifies the nth actual recipient added to the Zoho Sign request. Recipient numbers are contiguous field-ownership indexes, not permanent business-role IDs and not signing-order positions.

field_ownership_policy.observed_behavior: Some combined-recipient Sign Date probes created a field, but Zoho assigned it only to the first parsed recipient.
field_ownership_policy.rule: Field formation is not proof of joint ownership. Assign every field to exactly one R<n> recipient and repeat separate canonical tags for each intended signer.

landlord_final_signer_policy.business_role: GH Real Estate, LLC Authorized Representative
landlord_final_signer_policy.fixed_R4_rule: R4 is the landlord recipient only when exactly three actual non-landlord recipients precede GH Real Estate. With fewer or more preceding signers, use the next contiguous recipient number and keep GH Real Estate last.

recipients.business_role: GH Real Estate, LLC Authorized Representative
GH Real Estate, LLC Authorized Representative
GH Real Estate, LLC Authorized Representative

additional_signer_policy.rule: Add each actual guarantor, witness, or other governed signer before the landlord recipient, then assign GH Real Estate the next contiguous recipient number and the final signing position.

signing_order_policy.rule: Recipient numbers control field ownership only. Configure signing positions separately so every tenant, guarantor, witness, and other required non-landlord signer completes before GH Real Estate.
signing_order_policy.landlord_last_gate: Do not send unless the GHRE_LANDLORD recipient has the highest signing position and no signer is scheduled after it.

optional_signer_policy.rule: Optional people are omitted entirely. An actual named signer is never given an optional signature field.
optional_signer_policy.absent_signer_action: Remove the absent recipient, all related tags, and the signature row; then regenerate the remaining recipient manifest and tags with contiguous R-numbers.

validation_rules: Every signing document must declare a document-specific recipient manifest.
Recipient roles must be contiguous from R1 with no gaps.
Every signer must have at least one assigned field.
GH Real Estate must be the final actual recipient and must have the final signing position.
No signer may be routed after GH Real Estate.
R4 is valid for GH Real Estate only when three actual non-landlord recipients precede it.
Do not create dummy recipients merely to preserve an R-number.
Use only the canonical formatted Sign Date syntax approved by the active text-tag registry, with exactly one explicit recipient per tag and no asterisk.
Treat every combined-recipient field expression as invalid even if Zoho creates a field, because the observed field was assigned only to the first parsed recipient.
Use only production-safe tags approved by the active registry.

exceptions.rule: Any exception requires an explicit repository change, documented rationale, validation updates, and approval before live use.
exceptions.document_not_signed_by_gh: A document not signed by GH Real Estate is outside the landlord-final requirement but still requires a contiguous recipient manifest.
